verdict.rationale: Lago's developer page documents an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for generating clients or exposing billing actions to AI agents. A live probe confirms that https://getlago.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so the spec can be downloaded. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of where to download the spec and how it is versioned relative to the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use Lago's OpenAPI 3.1 schema to generate clients, inspect typed operations, or expose billing actions to an AI agent.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://getlago.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
